intro: One glass of teh C special (3 layer) is about 220 kcal. Most of the calories come from the gula melaka syrup at the bottom and the evaporated milk.
diet: Yes, but treat it as a 'treat' drink, not an everyday one. 220 kcal is about the same as a small plate of rice. Once a week when you lepak is no problem. Just don't make it a daily thing.
tips: Ask for 'kurang gula melaka' when you order.
Share one glass with a friend or your partner.
Stir and drink half, then add more ice to dilute it.

swap.name: Teh C ais kosong
swap.why: Still has that creamy milk tea taste, without the sugar syrup. You save about 160 kcal.

faq.q: Why does teh C special have 3 layers?
faq.a: The bottom is gula melaka, the middle is evaporated milk, and the top is tea. Their different densities keep them layered until you stir.

faq.q: Where does teh C special come from?
faq.a: It's popular in Sarawak, especially Kuching. Now many shops in the Peninsula sell it too.

faq.q: Is gula melaka healthier than white sugar?
faq.a: Gula melaka is still sugar. It smells and tastes nicer, but the calories are about the same.
